{{Quote|You are come within the Great Plan. These are but the Outer Precincts. There are several cubic kilometers of connected caves and tunnels, the Caverns of Forever. The roots of The Heart extend throughout them.|Mother Dariana, to the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="A Plague of Darkness">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: A Plague of Darkness}}</ref>}}
The '''cubic kilometer''' was a unit of volume. It corresponded to the volume of a cube with edges one [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] in length.
